description: Your own delivered price per cubic yard applied to the quarter-yard order quantity, with short-load fee, delivery, and bags against ready-mix. Estimate only; confirm with your plans, supplier and local code.

bagYield.description: Yield of one bag of the mix you buy, read on its bag: cu ft (imperial) or litres (metric). No default: without it no bag count is given.

count.description: How many columns. Shown on the site only when "shape=column" is set.

delivery.description: Delivery charge. Unit: $ flat. Optional. Flat haul or fuel charge, when it is billed separately.

diameter.description: Column diameter. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 30cm. Shown on the site only when "shape=column" is set.

footDepth.description: Footing depth. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 20cm. Shown on the site only when "shape=footing" is set.

footLength.description: Footing length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 12. Shown on the site only when "shape=footing" is set.

footWidth.description: Footing width. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 40cm. Shown on the site only when "shape=footing" is set.

height.description: Column height. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 2.7. Shown on the site only when "shape=column" is set.

length.description: Length. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 6. Shown on the site only when "shape=slab" is set.

minLoad.description: Producer minimum load. Unit: cu yd (imperial) or m³ (metric). Optional. Cubic yards. Leave blank unless your producer quotes one.

price.description: Ready-mix price. Unit: $ / cu yd (imperial) or $ / m³ (metric). Optional. Your delivered price, per the unit shown on the field. Leave blank to skip the cost.

pricePerBag.description: Price per bag. Unit: $ / bag. Optional. Fill it in to compare bags with a truck at your own prices.

shortFee.description: Short-load fee. Unit: $ flat. Optional. Flat charge your producer adds below that minimum.

system.description: Unit system the inputs are typed in and the defaults are taken from.

thickness.description: Thickness. Unit: in (imperial) or cm (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 10cm. Shown on the site only when "shape=slab" is set. Common practice: 4″ for patios and walks, 5″–6″ under vehicles. Confirm with your plans and local code.

waste.description: Waste allowance. Unit: %. Covers subgrade dips, spillage and the last wheelbarrow.

width.description: Width. Unit: ft (imperial) or m (metric). A number in that unit, or a string that carries its own unit such as "20 ft 6 in". Default in metric: 6. Shown on the site only when "shape=slab" is set.
